title: Peggy`s Cove Only Tour.
includes: This is not a narrative tour. You will be driven to the cove only and back to your starting point.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Peggy's Cove is one of the most unique, captivating and exhilarating, eye-opener in Nova Scotia. The quaint seaside Hamlets of Shad Bay, Big Lake, East Dover and West Dover, to mention but a few, are also breathtaking.

 Known as Canada's most famous fishing village, Peggy's Cove, with its famous glacier rocks, offers an attraction that predates the stone age. As well, visitors can see the Famous De Gathe Sculpture. We will stop here for about an hour and back to Halifax.
